overallNote: Overall Luke C0 verdict downgrades to NEEDS-METADATA because the SBLGNT text component of morphgnt/sblgnt is subject to a separate SBLGNT EULA and per-use permissions (derivative translation, redistribution, external LLM input, full-text storage) cannot be asserted as PASS without an explicit EULA review. TAGNT (STEPBible CC BY 4.0) and MorphGNT annotations (CC BY-SA 3.0 with share-alike obligation) independently PASS. koreanGlossActive.js is project-owned with inherited upstream attribution obligations. Do not proceed to Luke G2 candidate generation using SBLGNT text as an authoritative source until the EULA review resolves the flagged fields. TAGNT alone remains the primary Strong/lemma/transliteration inventory basis, and MorphGNT annotations may be used for cross-check under their CC BY-SA 3.0 obligations.
